subject: music
title: Note Values & Beats
welcome_lead: Semibreves, minims, crotchets — counting the beats.
meta_desc: KS3 rhythm: note values and how many beats each gets.
final_note: Note shape tells you how long to hold it.

walkthroughs.body_html: A semibreve is 4 beats (whole note). A minim is 2 beats (half). A crotchet is 1 beat (quarter). Each one halves the duration of the last.
A quaver is half a beat (eighth note). A semiquaver is a quarter of a beat. Stems can be joined with beams when you write them in groups.
In 4/4 time, every bar must contain 4 beats. So a bar might hold: 4 crotchets, or 2 minims, or 1 semibreve, or 8 quavers.
